# Geyer Instructional Products

> Geyer Instructional Products is a comprehensive educational supplier offering STEM, math, and science materials for K-12 schools and educators.

Based in Cincinnati, Geyer Instructional Products specializes in hands-on learning materials including robotics kits, math manipulatives, graphing tools, and STEM curricula. The company serves schools nationwide through direct sales, purchase orders, and a loyalty rewards program.

## Key Topics

- STEM supplies
- Math instructional materials
- Robotics kits
- Kinesthetic learning
- Classroom manipulatives
- Graphing tools
- Science labs
- Educational resources
- Teacher professional development
- Tax-exempt orders
- School purchase orders
- A+ Rewards program
- STEM grants
- Inclusive learning
- Hands-on curriculum

## Math Instructional Materials

- [Math Instructional Materials | Geyer Instructional Products](https://www.geyerinstructional.com/math): Math supplies catalog with graphing tools, manipulatives, and classroom essentials
- [Buy Math Graphing Products | Geyer Instructional Products](https://www.geyerinstructional.com/math/graphing): Math graphing products including graph paper, dry-erase boards, and tools
- [Math Products and Tools | Geyer Instructional Supplies](https://www.geyerinstructional.com/math/math-products): Math tools for algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics, and trigonometry
- [Math Activity Mats | Geyer Instructional Products](https://www.geyerinstructional.com/sensory/math-activities-mats): Kinesthetic math activity mats for hands-on learning and sensory activities
- [Math Books & Guides | Geyer Instructional Products](https://www.geyerinstructional.com/math/books): Math workbooks, study guides, and instructional materials by grade level
- [Eduscize | Geyer Instructional Products](https://www.geyerinstructional.com/math/eduscize): Eduscize curriculum merging academics with physical activity for K-5 students

## STEM & Science Products
